champions.name: Ashka the Kindled
lines: Stand still. It is quicker for both of us.
Embers go out. Mine just took longer than most.

champions.name: Sef of the Long Grass
lines: You will not see me twice in the same place.
You caught the wind. Nobody has told me how.

champions.name: Mother Brine
lines: Come closer, child. The water is warm.
The tide turns. Even for me, it seems.

champions.name: Old Grund
lines: Hide behind whatever you like. The rock does not mind.
Well. Mountains wear down too, I suppose.
